verdict.rationale: Brex offers a Transactions API to pull transaction data, an official MCP server that lets AI assistants 'manage expenses' and 'review banking transactions,' and AI features (audit/review agents) that categorize spend and flag policy violations (policy field on bookings, out-of-policy detection). However, the evidence never shows a specific 'uncoded transactions' filter/endpoint or an explicit write-back/update-category API call that pushes AI-proposed coding for human review — it only shows general expense/transaction read access and rule-based auto-approval. Missing for 10: explicit uncoded-transaction query capability, explicit category/coding update endpoint, and documented human-review workflow tying AI-proposed codes back to approval.
